description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LinkRendererTest' that tests link rendering functionalities within a Markdown content type for the Confluence formatter. It specifically tests the conversion of various Markdown link syntaxes into HTML, including external links, internal page links, anchors, mailto links, and links with children nodes.

classes.name: LinkRendererTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing Markdown link rendering in Confluence format, utilizing the vfsStream for virtual filesystem setup and a custom converter for HTML output verification.

methods.name: providerRenderLink
methods.description: A data provider method that supplies various Markdown link strings, expected HTML outputs, and current page paths for testing link rendering correctness.

methods.name: testRenderLink
methods.description: A test method that verifies the conversion of Markdown links to HTML links, using the data from providerRenderLink and asserting the generated HTML matches expectations.
